title_sq: NJESI KOMERCIALE OPENSPACE PER SHITJE NE REZIDENCEN KINOBLOCK, PORCELAN !!

title_en: OPENSPACE COMMERCIAL UNIT FOR SALE IN KINOBLOCK RESIDENCE, PORCELAIN!!
description_en: KinoBlock Residence Residential and service complex consisting of 5 towers of 10 floors and 2 floors of underground parking. This project is organized with green spaces, connecting roads with the new buildings. The service facilities project for the Health Center, Kindergarten, 9-Year-Old School and the newly completed High School is also being developed nearby. The area is currently in the development stage, like all the new complexes that are being built, but also because of the big ring which has started the works and adds value and access to the area. General information: * Location: Kinoblock Residence on Rugen e Kokonozeve, Porcelan * Positioned overlooking the main road * Openspace * 10m glass facade * Net area = 118.43 m2 * Floor height = 5m For more information, please contact me!
